question: Does the cost estimate appear before saving, or after?
context: Audit found one step in the agreed scope that nothing serves.

options.label: Before saving
options.buys: nobody is surprised by a charge
options.costs: the estimate must be computed on a file that does not exist yet

options.label: After saving, before publishing
options.buys: an exact number instead of an estimate
options.kills: the promise that nothing happens until you choose

right_if: Before wins if arrivals are price-sensitive rather than already committed.

question: Does search include removed files?
context: Search was designed after Removed already existed; the two features were not built together.

options.label: Include, marked as removed
options.buys: a file someone half-remembers deleting is still findable
options.costs: every result needs a removed indicator, even when nothing is removed
options.kills: a result list that is just files

options.label: Exclude removed files entirely
options.buys: search only ever returns things the person can use right now
options.costs: a removed file is invisible to search on top of being out of the list
options.kills: finding a file you deleted an hour ago without opening Removed

right_if: Include wins if removal is read as "out of the way" rather than "gone" — see files-removed.
